The '''Winter End Table''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|800}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{tprice|furniture}}. It can also be purchased from the [[Traveling Cart|Traveling Merchant]]'s shop at the [[Festival of Ice]] for {{Price|1000}}. It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

There is a small chance to receive this furniture item from slaying [[monsters]], breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]], chopping [[trees]], shaking trees with seeds, digging [[Artifact Spot]]s, or [[Pans|panning]].<ref name="rarecosmeticdrop" />
